descriptions.notStarted: I've completed all Bounty Hunter bounties for Lita Lawless! I think its about time I'm deputized!  I should head to New Leaf City and find out more!
descriptions.inProgress: I spoke with Lita, and she's all set to deputize me whenever I'm ready!  Completing all those quests was hard, but well worth the effort!
descriptions.completed: I've been deputized by Lita Lawless as an official protector of New Leaf City!  I've sworn to defend the area, and Masteria in general from all future threats...and from what it looks like, there's going to be a lot of them!
